title: Markdown heading marker
rationale: Tests whether removing the visual heading marker and adding a full stop improves the opening cadence.
originalText: # Getting started
expectedPreparedText: Getting started.

title: Uppercase heading
rationale: Tests whether explicit terminal punctuation helps a short heading without changing its words.
originalText: IMPORTANT SETTINGS
expectedPreparedText: IMPORTANT SETTINGS.

title: Dash bullet
rationale: Tests whether naming a bullet is clearer than relying on Kokoro to interpret a leading dash.
originalText: - Keep the original voice.
expectedPreparedText: Bullet. Keep the original voice.

title: Unicode bullet
rationale: Checks the same treatment for a pasted typographic bullet.
originalText: • Restore the clipboard after reading.
expectedPreparedText: Bullet. Restore the clipboard after reading.

title: Numbered item
rationale: Tests whether an explicit item label sounds better than the bare list number.
originalText: 2. Select the voice you want to hear.
expectedPreparedText: Item 2. Select the voice you want to hear.

title: Unchecked task
rationale: Makes the state of a Markdown task explicit instead of reading punctuation.
originalText: - [ ] Start Pulse Reader with Windows.
expectedPreparedText: Unchecked item. Start Pulse Reader with Windows.

title: Checked task
rationale: Makes a completed Markdown task explicit.
originalText: - [x] Kokoro is installed locally.
expectedPreparedText: Checked item. Kokoro is installed locally.

title: Quoted line
rationale: Tests an audible quote cue in place of the visual greater-than marker.
originalText: > Please read this quoted response aloud.
expectedPreparedText: Quote. Please read this quoted response aloud.

title: Bold and italic Markdown
rationale: Removes paired visual emphasis markers while preserving every word.
originalText: Use **Kokoro** for _local_ speech.
expectedPreparedText: Use Kokoro for local speech.

title: Inline code hotkey
rationale: Removes backticks and expands Ctrl so the key chord is less ambiguous.
originalText: Press `Ctrl + Shift + Space` to begin reading.
expectedPreparedText: Press Control plus Shift plus Space to begin reading.

title: Word ampersand
rationale: Tests a narrow ampersand expansion only when it joins words.
originalText: Research & development teams use the same build.
expectedPreparedText: Research and development teams use the same build.

title: Visually wrapped sentence
rationale: Checks whether removing a visual line wrap changes Kokoro's pause or cadence.
originalText:
This sentence was wrapped
across two visual lines before it reached Pulse Reader.
expectedPreparedText: This sentence was wrapped across two visual lines before it reached Pulse Reader.

title: Tabs and repeated spaces
rationale: Checks whether collapsing layout whitespace affects spoken timing.
originalText: Voice:	 af_heart   is selected.
expectedPreparedText: Voice: af_heart is selected.

title: Web address control
rationale: Makes the URL scheme colon and path dash audible without spelling out the structural slashes.
originalText: Open https://example.com/pulse-reader/docs for details.
expectedPreparedText: Open https colon example.com/pulse dash reader/docs for details.

title: Email address control
rationale: Leaves an email address untouched rather than guessing how it should be expanded.
originalText: Send the report to reader.tests@example.org tomorrow.
expectedPreparedText: Send the report to reader.tests@example.org tomorrow.

title: Version and decimal control
rationale: Checks Kokoro's native handling before introducing version or number rules.
originalText: Version 2.1.0 reduced the delay from 5.5 seconds to 1.25 seconds.
expectedPreparedText: Version 2.1.0 reduced the delay from 5.5 seconds to 1.25 seconds.

title: Windows path control
rationale: Makes the drive colon and file-extension dot audible while retaining the structural backslashes.
originalText: The model is stored at C:\Users\Reader\Models\kokoro.onnx.
expectedPreparedText: The model is stored at C colon \Users\Reader\Models\kokoro dot onnx.

title: Acronyms control
rationale: Tests whether Kokoro already pronounces common technical acronyms well.
originalText: The CPU runs TTS locally while the GPU remains available.
expectedPreparedText: The CPU runs TTS locally while the GPU remains available.

title: Ellipsis control
rationale: Preserves intentional punctuation so we can hear Kokoro's natural pause.
originalText: Wait... is the next voice ready? Yes, it is.
expectedPreparedText: Wait... is the next voice ready? Yes, it is.

title: Date and time control
rationale: Tests Kokoro's native reading of a date and twenty-four-hour time.
originalText: The test starts on 24 August 2026 at 14:35.
expectedPreparedText: The test starts on 24 August 2026 at 14:35.

title: Currency control
rationale: Checks whether currency already sounds natural without a replacement rule.
originalText: The monthly total changed from £12.50 to £9.99.
expectedPreparedText: The monthly total changed from £12.50 to £9.99.

title: Simple expression control
rationale: Leaves mathematical notation exact because expanding operators can change meaning.
originalText: The expression is x >= 10, and the result is y = x * 2.
expectedPreparedText: The expression is x >= 10, and the result is y = x * 2.

title: JSON block control
rationale: Keeps structured data intact until we decide whether it should be read, summarized, or skipped.

title: Fenced code control
rationale: Preserves code exactly because a generic spoken rewrite would be unreliable.

title: Table control
rationale: Preserves the table for now so the baseline exposes how poorly or well Kokoro handles it unaided.
originalText:
Voice | Speed | Volume
Heart | 1.0 | 100
George | 0 | 100
expectedPreparedText:
Voice | Speed | Volume
Heart | 1.0 | 100
George | 0 | 100
